title: Nvidia doubles down on Taiwan supply chain as AI squeezes substrate and OSAT capacity
html: Nvidia is deepening its ties with Taiwan's artificial intelligence supply chain by issuing capacity prepayments to fund expansion across IC substrates, advanced packaging, and testing—locking in production capacity for the next three to five years despite...
summary: Nvidia is deepening its ties with Taiwan's artificial intelligence supply chain by issuing capacity prepayments to fund expansion across IC substrates, advanced packaging, and testing—locking in production capacity for the next three to five years despite ongoing uncertainty over its CEO succession.
